stories.title: Mold theatre to stage A Doll’s House, The Secret Garden and new Lucie Lovatt thriller
stories.summary: Theatr Clwyd in Mold has announced its spring 2027 season, featuring three new productions. The season opens with Simon Stephens’ adaptation of Henrik Ibsen’s A Doll’s House, running from 27 March to 17 April, directed by Dena Davies, who recently completed Theatr Clwyd’s emerging director programme. stories.title: North Wales Police visit 56 children in month-long online safety operation
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s Online Child Abuse Investigation Team carried out 56 visits to children and family members during August as part of a month-long safety operation. stories.title: Simply Red to play Chester Racecourse in August 2027
stories.summary: Simply Red will play Chester Racecourse next summer, with the band confirmed to headline the venue’s Open Course on Saturday 7 August 2027.
